tshor ba dag gis nyen pa la ltung ba med do/ /lo drug tu bcang ba'i spang ba ste bcu bzhi pa rdzogs s+ho// //'dul ba rnam par 'byed pa/ bam po sum bcu rtsa gnyis pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ba ra na bzhugs so/ /gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis bla na med pa'i mkhyen pa thugs su chud pa de'i tshe na thams cad du yul dbus su sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byung zhes grag go zhes sgra grags so/ /byang lam na tshong pa dag gis yul dbus su sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byung ste/ gang dag de la mchod pa dag byed pa de dag gi mchod pa byas pa de dag ni shin tu 'bras bu che ba dang / phan yon che ba dang / gsal ba che ba dang / rgya chen por 'gyur ro zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang de dag 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag cag zong dag thogs te mnyan yod du 'dong zhing der bdag cag gis khe spogs kyang bsgrub par bya/ bcom ldan 'das la yang bsnyen bkur bya'o snyam du rig nas tshong pa lnga brgya byang lam nas zong dag thogs te yul dbus su 'phags so/ /de dag mthar gyis mnyan yod du phyin nas de dag gis zong mkhos su phab ste/ khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin ga la ba der dong nas phyin pa dang / khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin la 'di skad ces smras so/ /khyim bdag bdag cag sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das blta bar 'dod do/ /shes ldan dag de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa rnams ni blta bar bya ba rin po che kho na yin te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni 'di lta ste/ dper na u dum bā ra'i me tog ltar bltams pa dang / 'byung ba dkon pa yin no/ /de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis tshong pa lnga brgya po de dag khrid nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te mtha' gcig tu 'dug go/ /mtha' gcig tu 'dug nas bcom

ldan 'das tshong pa de dag la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par ston par mdzad/ yang dag par 'dzin du 'jud par mdzad/ yang dag par gzengs stod par mdzad/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad do/ /rnam grangs du mas chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par bstan/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcug /yang dag par gzengs bstod/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad nas cang mi gsung ngo / /de nas tshong pa de dag gis bcom ldan 'das la bsnyen bkur byas nas/ dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan rnams kyi gtsug lag khang blta bar brtsams pa dang / tshong pa de dag gis dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan rnams kyi mal dag na gding ba dbus rdol ba dag mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin la 'di skad ces smras so/ /khyim bdag ci'i phyir dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan 'di dag gi gding ba dag dbus rdol bar gyur/ khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis smras pa/ bdag nyid chen po 'di dag ni phal cher mtshan mo skyil mo krung gis 'da' bar byed do/ /de dag sems mngon par dad par gyur nas dad pa skyes pa de dag gis dge slong rnams la ras yug chen lnga brgya phul lo/ /dge slong rnams kyis gding ba rnying pa de dag khang pa chen po'i gtsug lag khang bla gab med pa zhig tu bzhag go/ /de'i tshe khyim bdag cig gis sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun khyim gzhan du gdugs tshod la spyan drangs pa dang / dge slong gi dge 'dun ni zhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das ni rdzas las byung ba na bzhugs shing bsod snyoms mngon par bsgrubs so/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni rgyu lngas rdzas las byung ba na bzhugs shing bsod snyoms mngon par sgrub pa mdzad de/ lnga gang zhe na/ nang du yang dag 'jog par bzhed pa dang / lha rnams la chos ston par bzhed pa dang / nad pa la blta bar bzhed pa dang / gnas mal la rtog par bzhed pa dang / 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhi bca' bar bzhed pa'o/ /don 'dir ni bcom ldan

'das gnas mal la rtog par bzhed pa dang / 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhi bca' bar bzhed pas/ rdzas las byung ba ni bzhugs shing bsod snyoms mngon par sgrub pa mdzad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong gi dge 'dun song nas ring po ma lon par thugs su chud nas lde mig bsnams te kun dga'i ra ba nas/ kun dga'i ra bar/ gtsug lag khang nas gtsug lag khang du/ khang khyim nas khang khyim du/ 'chag sa nas 'chag sa dang / gol bar gshegs shing mthar gyis gshegs pa na khang pa chen po'i gtsug lag khang ga la ba der gshegs so/ /de'i tshe na khang pa chen po'i gtsug lag khang de na gding ba rnying pa rdol ba dang ral bas rdul gyi phye ma dang 'dres pa rab tu mang po dag sa la bkram zhing 'dug go/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gding ba rnying pa rdol ba dang / ral ba sa rdul gyi phye ma dang 'dres pa rab tu mang po dag sa la bkram zhing 'dug pa dag gzigs so/ /gzigs nas kyang e ma zhes gsung zhing smad nas 'di snyam du dgongs te/ bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can dag gis pags pa dang / sha dang / khrag dag btsir cing btsir cing sbyin pa dag sbyin/ bsod nams dag byed pa gang yin pa de la dge slong dag drod mi shes pa dang / so sor mi rtog par yongs su longs spyod par byed do snyam du dgongs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gding ba rnying pa de dag legs par brtul cing sprugs nas bting zhing bskams te rtsig pa la mi reg par mdzad nas/ gtsug lag khang gi slad rol du zhabs gnyis bsil te nang du yang dag 'jog gi slad du gtsug lag khang du gshegs so/ /de nas dge slong bsod snyoms sgrub pas/ bsod snyoms blangs nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ngo / /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni chos nyid kyi bsod snyoms sgrub pa'i dge slong la dge slong las ji ltar zas bsod dam/ dge slong gi dge 'dun tshim par byas sam zhes so sor kun dga' bar mdzad pa 'dis so sor kun dga' bar

mdzad pa yin pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong bsod snyoms sgrub pa la/ dge slong ji ltar zas bsod dam/ dge slong gi dge 'dun tshim par byas sam zhes so sor kun dga' bar mdzad pa dang / des gsol pa/ btsun pa te bor zas bsod cing dge slong gi dge 'dun tshim par bgyis so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das zhal zas kyi bya ba mdzad nas/ gtsug lag khang gi slad rol du zhabs gnyis bsil te nang du yang dag 'jog gi slad du gtsug lag khang du gshegs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das phyi dro nang du yang dag 'jog las bzhengs nas/ dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gong du gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /bzhugs nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag 'di na ngas dge slong gi dge 'dun song nas ring po ma lon par shes nas lde mig khyer te/ kun dga'i ra ba nas kun dga'i ra bar/ gtsug lag khang nas gtsug lag khang du/ khang khyim nas khang khyim du/ 'chag sa nas 'chag sar dang / gol bar song zhing mthar gyis 'gro ba na khang pa chen po'i gtsug lag khang zhig ga la ba der phyin nas ngas khang pa chen po'i gtsug lag khang de na gding ba rnying pa rdol ba dang ral ba sa rdul gyi phye ma dang 'dres pa rab tu mang po dag sa la bkram zhing 'dug pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang e ma zhes byas te smad nas 'di snyam du bram ze dang / khyim bdag dad pa can dag gis pags pa dang / sha dang / khrag dag btsir cing btsir cing sbyin pa dag sbyin/ bsod nams dag byed pa gang yin pa de la dge slong dag drod mi shes pa dang / so sor mi rtog par yongs su longs spyod par byed do snyam du dgongs kyis/ dge slong dag khyed kyis dad pas sbyin par bya ba la/ drod ran par yongs su longs spyad pa dang / spang zhing yongs su longs spyad pa dang / dus su yongs su longs spyad pa dang / brtag cing yongs su longs spyad pa dang / khad kyis yongs su longs spyad na legs so// //bar sdom la/ drod ran pa dang spang ba dang / /de

bzhin dus dang brtag pa dang / /khad kyis yongs su spyad pa yin/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis drod ran pa dang / spang ba dang / dus dang / brtag pa dang / khad kyis yongs su longs spyad pa'i bsngags pa brjod nas dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na phan yon bcu yang dag par gzigs pas 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhi bca' bar bya ste/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /nga'i nyan thos rnams kyis 'dul ba la bslab pa'i gzhi 'di ltar gdon par bya ste/ dge slong gis gding ba sar pa byed na sar pa bya kha dog mi sdug par bya ba'i phyir gding ba rnying pa bde bar gshegs pa'i mtho gang 'khor bas glan par bya'o/ /gal te dge slong gis sar pa kha dog mi sdug par bya ba'i phyir gding ba rnying pa bde bar gshegs pa'i mtho gang 'khor bas ma glan par gding ba sar pa spyod na spang ba'i ltung byed do/ /dge slong gis zhes bya ba ni chos 'di pas so/ /gding ba zhes bya ba ni so sor gding ba'o/ /sar pa zhes bya ba ni sar pa gnyis te/ gsar pas sar pa dang / rnyed pas sar pa ste/ don 'dir ni gsar pas sar pa yin par dgongs so/ /byed na zhes bya ba ni bdag nyid kyis sam/ gzhan byed du 'jug na'o/ /sar pa kha dog mi sdug par bya ba'i phyir zhes bya ba ni sar pa sra bar bya ba'i phyir ro/ /gding ba rnying pa bde bar gshegs pa'i mtho gang 'khor bas glan par bya'o zhes bya ba ni gal te de la gding ba rnying pa bde bar gshegs pa'i mtho gang 'khor ba gzhan yod na'o/ /bde bar gshegs pa zhes bya ba ni ston pa'o/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i mtho gang la ni tshad dang ldan pa'i khru'i khru phyed dang do yod do/ /'khor bas zhes bya ba ni kun nas mtho re yod pas so/ /glan par bya'o zhes bya ba ni sbyar bar bya ba'o/ /ma glan par zhes bya ba ni ma sbyar bar ro/ /spang ba'i ltung byed do zhes bya ba ni dngos po de spangs nas ltung byed kyi ltung ba bshags par bya ba ste/ des na spang ba'i ltung byed do zhes gsungs

so/ /de la ltung bar ji ltar 'gyur zhe na/ dge slong gis gding ba rnying pa bde bar gshegs pa'i mtho gang 'khor bas ma glan par ji tsam cung zad du gding ba sar pa spyod par byed na thams cad du spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /gding ba rnying pa thams cad kyi thams cad du sha zad pa dang / bug rdol du gyur pa dang / bcos su mi rung ba yin na ltung ba med do/ /de tsam med na ltung ba med do/ /las dang po pa dang / smyos pa dang / sems 'khrugs pa dang / tshor ba dag gis nyen pa la ltung ba med do/ /mtho gang gi spang ba ste bcwa lnga pa rdzogs s+ho// //sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /drug sde dag gis smras pa/ dga' bo nye dga' lhung bzed nag po can 'di dag ni rkang pa spre'u'i zhag gis bskus te 'gro na yang 'gro bar chas pa'i rnyed pa sgrub par byed/ 'ong na yang blo bur du 'ongs pa'i rnyed pa sgrub par byed cing skye bo mang po dga' ba dang / yid du 'ong bar yang 'gyur ro/ /yu bu cag ni khron pa'i rus sbal dang 'dra bar gar yang mi 'dong / gang nas kyang mi 'ong bas rnyed pa 'thob pa dang / skye bo mang po dga' ba dang / yid du 'ong bar ga la 'gyur gyis yu bu cag kyang 'dong ngo / /gang du 'dong / gang du don mthun 'grub par ro/ /de dag gis bsams pa/ gal te thams cad dong bar 'gyur na bdag cag gi nye bar spyod pa'i khyim gang dag yin pa de dag kyang lhung bzed nag po can dag gis rjes su 'jug par byed par 'gyur gyis/ bdag cag gis gcig bzhag ste 'dong bar bya na su bzhag par bya/ btsun pa 'char ka'o/ /btsun pa 'char ka khyod 'di nyid du 'dug shig /kho bo cag 'dong bar bya'o/ /de bzhin gyis shig ces 'char ka de nyid du 'dug go/ /lnga po dag gis don mthun btsal bar brtsams pa dang / de dag gis bal yul du 'gro ba'i don mthun mthong nas/ de'i drung du song ste smras pa/ bzhin bzangs dag khyed gang du 'phags/ 'phags pa dag bal yul du'o/ /bzhin

bzangs dag kho bo cag kyang khyed dang lhan cig 'dong ngo / /'phags pa dag bal yul ni rnga mo'i rgyab 'dra ba lags pas/ khyed cag der dgyes par mi 'gyur ro/ /bzhin bzangs dag gal te de lta bu yin du zin kyang / yul mthong bar 'gyur bas 'dong bar bya'o/ /'phags pa dag gal te de lta na tshur spyon bzhud do/ /drug sde dag don mthun de dag dang lhan cig bal yul du 'phags nas mthar gyis bal yul du phyin pa dang / nyi ma gang kho na la bal yul du phyin pa'i nyi ma de nyid la mngon par mi dga' bar gyur nas de dag nang par sngar langs te lam srang du dong ba dang / tshong pa dag gis drug sde dag mthong nas de dag gi rkang pa la phyag 'tshal te smras pa/ 'phags pa dag bal yul ci 'dra/ khyed cag mngon par mi dgyes par ma gyur tam/ bzhin bzangs dag nyi ma gang kho na la bal yul du phyin pa'i nyi ma de nyid la mngon par mi dga' bar gyur to/ /'phags pa dag bdag cag gis khyed la dang po kho na nas bal yul ni rnga mo'i rgyab 'dra ba lags pas/ khyed cag der dgyes par mi 'gyur ro zhes ma bgyis sam/ bzhin bzangs dag ci de lta na 'gro'am 'dong ngo / /'phags pa dag bdag cag gis zong ma bsgyur de de lta lags mod kyi 'on kyang bdag cag dang bshes pa'i tshong pa gzhan dag mchis pa de dag gis zong bsgyur bas de dag la gtad par bgyis de dag dang thabs cig bzhud cig /drug sde dag gis smras pa/ de ma nongs kyis de bzhin bgyi'o/ /bal yul na bal dang ldong ros gnyis mod pas don mthun de dag gis bal gyis shing rta bkang ste chas pa dang / drug sde dag kyang don mthun de dang lhan cig 'phags so/ /drug sde dag gi kun du spyod pa ni rdul gyis 'jigs pas yang na ni don mthun gyi mdun du 'gro/ yang na ni phyi bzhin 'brang zhing 'gro bas de dag don mthun gyi phyi bzhin 'gro bar brtsams pa dang / ji tsam na tshong pa de dag gi shing rta'i srog shing chag nas tshong pa de dag gis bsams pa/ gal te shing rta'i srog shing bcos na sgras chom rkun pa dag

'ong bar 'gyur zhing de dag gis dang por bdag cag bsad par 'gyur la de'i 'og tu nor yang phrogs par 'gyur gyis/ bdag cag gis gces pa dag khyer te 'dong ngo snyam nas yid mi dga' zhing 'khod pa dang / drug sde dag lhags nas de dag gis smras pa/ shes ldan dag ci'i phyir yid mi dga' zhing 'khod/ 'phags pa dag shing rta'i srog shing chag ste gal te shing rta'i srog shing bcos na sgras chom rkun pa dag mchis par 'gyur zhing de dag gis dang por bdag cag bkum par 'gyur la/ de'i 'og tu nor yang phrogs par 'gyur bas bdag cag gis gces pa dag 'tshal de mchi'o snyam nas yid mi dga' zhing mchis so/ /bzhin bzangs dag khyod kyis bal dag yongs su btang ngam/ yongs su btang ngo / /gal te khyed cag la mi gnod na zhwa dang / lham sgrog gu can dang / stod kor nang tshangs can dang / rgya cang dang / lcag pod dang / shur bu phre'u la sogs pa'i don du cung zhig bskur ro/ /'phags pa dag bdag cag la 'dis ci bgyi/ thams cad snoms shig /drug sde dag gis smras pa/ dga' bo nye dga' phyag dar khrod pa rnyed do zhes de dag gis lnga car gyi lhung bzed dang chos gos dag gcig gis bskur nas/ mi bzhis de nyid las thag pa bkal de khur bo che ba bzhi drags nas/ de dag gis de khur te dong ngo / /de dag gis khur de dag khyer te 'phags pa dang / tshong pa de dag gis drug sde dag bal gyi khur blangs te phyi bzhin 'ongs pa mthong nas smras pa/ 'phags pa dag bdag cag gis gla mi dag khrid de mchi'o snyam du bsams nas/ khyed cag gis bal 'di thams cad bsnams de byon gyis 'phags pa dag la gla gsol lo/ /bkren pa dag kho bo cag khyod kyi gla mi dag yin nam/ 'phags pa dag mad kyang bzhad gad bgyi'o/ /don mthun de'i nang na mu stegs can dag cig 'dong ba de dag gis smras pa/ kye ma drug sde dag khyed cag gang du khur 'jig par 'gyur/ gang du rnyed pa 'grub par 'gyur/ khyod kyi ma'i lto dral te der khur 'jig par 'gyur

zhing der rnyed pa 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /drug sde dag gis smras pa/ dga' bo nye dga' gal te don mthun dang lhan cig 'dong na tho 'tsham pa mang du 'byung gis don mthun gyi mdun du 'dong ngo zhes de dag don mthun gyi mdun du 'phags te dong ba dang / ri brags shig na chom rkun pa gcad pa'i phyir yang rgod kyi mi mang po bkod cing 'khod pa de dag gis de dag thag ring po kho na nas mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang nyam nga bar gyur nas de dag gis smras pa/ shes ldan dag glang po che dang bcas pa'i dmag byung ngo zhes ri brags pa de dag thams cad skrag nas nags khrod du byer ro/ /de dag gi nang nas kha cig gis smras pa/ 'di dag ni glang po che dang bcas pa'i dmag ma yin gyi 'di ltar rnga mo dag cig 'ong ba yin no/ /kha cig gis smras pa/ 'di dag ni rnga mo ma yin gyi 'di ltar glang dag cig yin no/ /kha cig gis smras pa/ 'di dag ni glang ma yin gyi 'di dag ni khur thogs pa dag cig yin no/ /de dag thag nye bar gyur pa dang / yang rgod de dag gis smras pa/ 'phags pa dag khyed cag 'di lta bu'i khur dag thogs pas de'i phyir ri brags pa thams cad skrag ste nags khrod du byer ro/ /bkren pa dag gal te chom rkun pa dag gis khyed cag de dag bred ngas par shes par gyur na nyin mo'i nyi ma kho na la yang bcings te nags khrod du khrid par 'gyur ro/ /dga' bo nye dga' gal te lam du 'dong na tho 'tsham pa mang du 'byung gis lam gol bar 'dong ngo / /zhes de dag lam gol bar zhugs te dong ba dang / sho gam pa dag gis tshong pa sho gam 'dral ba bsgugs pa'i phyir 'ge gu pa'i mi mang po dag bkod cing 'khod pa de dag gis de dag mthong nas smras pa/ e ma'o tshong pa sho gam 'dral ba dag ci'i phyir sho gam dral te 'dong / bkren pa dag kho bo cag khyed kyi tshong pa sho gam 'dral ba dag yin nam/ khyed cag su yin/ 'phags pa drug sde dag yin no/ /bzhud cig de dag gis smras pa/ dga' bo nye dga' gal te rgyal byed kyi tshal gyi sgo nas zhugs na

lhung bzed nag po can dag las tho 'tsham pa mang du 'byung gis sge'u chung nas 'jug par bya'o zhes de dag sge'u chung nas zhugs pa dang / rgan zhugs zhig gis mthong nas des smras pa/ e ma'o khur tsa ba dag ci'i phyir grong dral te 'jug par byed/ rgan zhugs kho bo cag khyod kyi khur tsa ba dag yin nam/ des smras pa khyed su yin/ tshe dang ldan pa drug sde dag yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa dag byon pa legs so byon pa legs so/ /de dag nang du zhugs nas de dag gi bal gyi khur de dag bshig pa dang / ri rab kyi rnam pa 'dra ba'i phung po chen por rnam par gnas so/ /de dag la dge slong rnams kyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag khyed cag khur 'di lta bu dag thogs nas khyed la tho 'tsham pa dag mi 'byung ngam/ tshe dang ldan pa dag khyed ci kho bo cag gis bza' ba kho na'i phyir kha mngon par bsgrubs sam/ gang kho bo cag la tho 'tsham par byed pa de la kho bo cag gis kyang nyis gyur sbyin par bya'o/ /dge slong dag don nyung ba dag ci'i phyir/ dge slong dag yan lag gang gis ngo tsha bar bya ba'i yan lag de nyid kyis khengs par byed ces smod par byed/ phyar ka gtong bar byed/ kha zer bar byed pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byung ba 'di dang / gleng gzhi 'di dang / skabs 'di la dge slong gi dge 'dun bsdu ba mdzad do zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mkhyen bzhin du rmed par mdzad pa ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa yang snga ma bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis drug sde dag la rmas pa/ dge slong dag khyed kyis mi mdzes pa de lta bu de byas par gyur pa bden nam/ btsun pa mad do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge sbyong gi tshul ma yin pa/ rjes su mthun pa ma yin pa/ rung ba ma yin pa/ tshul dang mthun pa ma yin pa de ni rab tu byung bas bya ba ma yin no zhes rnam par smad pa mdzad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rnam

grangs du mas rnam par smad pa mdzad nas/ dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na phan yon bcu yang dag par gzigs pas 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhi bca' bar bya ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /nga'i nyan thos rnams kyis 'dul ba la bslab pa'i gzhi 'di ltar gdon par bya ste/ dge slong lam du zhugs pas lug bal dag rnyed la 'dod na dge slong des blang bar bya'o/ /blangs nas khyer ba med na dpag tshad gsum gyi mtha'i bar du bdag nyid kyis bkur bar bya'o/ /de las 'das par khyer na spang ba'i ltung byed do/ /dge slong zhes bya ba ni drug sde dag gam/ gzhan yang de lta bu gang yin pa'o/ /lam du zhugs pas zhes bya ba ni/ dgon pa'i lam du zhugs pas so/ /lug bal dag ces bya ba ni lug gi bal dag go/ /rnyed pa zhes bya ba ni gzhan las so/ /'dod na zhes bya ba ni gal te don du gnyer na'o/ /dge slong des blang bar bya'o zhes bya ba ni mnod par bya ba'o/ /blangs nas khyer ba med na zhes bya ba ni rung ba byed pa med na'o/ /dpag tshad gsum gyi mtha'i bar du zhes bya ba ni dpag tshad gsum gyi mthar thug pa'i bar tshun chad du'o/ /bdag nyid kyis bkur bar bya'o/ /zhes bya ba ni bdag rang gis bkur bar bya ba'o/ /de las 'das par khyer na zhes bya ba ni de las thal bar khyer na'o/ /spang ba'i ltung byed do zhes bya ba ni dngos po de spangs nas ltung byed kyi ltung ba bshags par bya ba ste/ des na spang ba'i ltung byed do zhes gsungs so/ /de la ltung bar ji ltar 'gyur zhe na/ dge slong gis lug bal dag rnyed la khyer ba med na bdag nyid kyis dpag tshad gsum gyi mtha' las 'das par khyer na rgyang grags phyed du phyin na nyes byas su 'gyur la/ rgyang grags kyi mthar phyin na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /khyer ba yod bzhin du bdag nyid kyis khyer na rtsom pa'i dus kho na na nyes byas su 'gyur la/ rgyang grags phyed du phyin na nyes byas su gzhan gcig tu 'gyur/ rgyang grags

kyi mthar phyin na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /rdul phra rab drug la rdul phra mo gcig go/ /rdul phra mo drug la chu rdul gcig go/ /chu rdul drug la lcag rdul gcig go/ /lcag rdul drug la ri bong gi rdul gcig go/ /ri bong rdul drug la lug rdul gcig go/ /lug rdul drug la glang rdul gcig go/ /glang rdul drug la nyi zer gyi rdul gcig go/ /nyi zer gyi rdul drug la sro ma gcig go/ /sro ma drug la shig gcig go/ /shig drug la nas gcig go/ /nas drug la sor gcig go/ /sor bzhi drug la khru gang ngo / /khru phyed dang bzhi la mi'i srid do/ /khru bzhi la gzhu'o/ /gzhu lnga brgya la rgyang grags gcig go/ /rgyang grags brgyad la dpag tshad gcig go/ /de la dge slong dgon pa pa lam du zhugs pas lug bal dag rnyed la/ de blangs te khyer ba med na rgyang grags kyis chod pa'i grong bdun po dag gi grong phyed du ni nyes byas su 'gyur la/ grong gi mthar ni spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /grong nas dgon pa'i lam du 'jug na rgyang grags phyed phyed du nyes byas su 'gyur la/ rgyang grags re rer spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /zhwa dang / lham sgrog gu can dang / stod kor nang tshangs can dang / rgya cang dang / lcag pod dang / shur bu phre'u la sogs pa'i don du de tsam dag khyer ba la ni ltung ba med do/ /las dang po pa dang / smyos pa dang / sems 'khrugs pa dang / tshor ba dag gis nyen pa la ltung ba med do/ /bal thogs pa'i spang ba ste bcu drug pa rdzogs s+ho// //sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /drug sde dag gis smras pa/ dga' bo nye dga' ba la bgo bar bya'o/ /cha dur bya de dag gis smras pa/ bdag cag gis btsun pa 'char ka 'di nyid na 'dug 'dug pa la ci'i phyir skal ba sbyin/ cha lngar bya'o/ /'char kas thos nas des smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag khyed kyis der rnyed pa gang grub pa de yang khyed kyis gyis shig /kho bo 'di nyid na 'dug 'dug

pas rnyed pa gang grub pa de yang kho bo nyid kyir bya'o/ /nye dga'as bsams pa 'di 'di na 'dug 'dug pas rnyed pa mang po grub gor ma chag snyam nas des smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag bdag cag dus thams cad du drug sde yin na da ci'i phyir lnga sder 'gyur bar bya/ cha drug kho nar bya'o su dgod du gzhug /btsun pa 'char ka ma dub pa yin gyis de 'god du gzhug go/ /'char kas cha drug tu byas te bdag nyid kyi skal ba rang gi gnas khang du bcug ste bzhag go/ /de dag gis smras pa/ btsun pa 'char ka khyod kyis rnyed pa gang grub pa de khyer shog bgo'o/ /'char kas smras pa/ kho bos de'i bar du ka ka ṇi gcig tsam yang ma rnyed do/ /khyod kyis kho bo cag bslus so/ /'char kas bsams pa/ bdag gis bal nyung ngu ma zhig rnyed pa 'di su rmel du gzhug /gal te khyim pa dag la bcol na ni de dag bslab pa yang dag par ma blangs pa yin pas thams cad brkus par 'gyur ro/ /gal te bcu gnyis sde dag la bcol na ni bca' ba'i rin du 'jog par 'gyur ro/ /chos byin la bcol yang chos byin ni mdo sde'i mtha' pa yin la/ 'khor yang mdo sde'i mtha' pa dang ldan pa yin pas mdo sde'i tshig dag sems pa na dus 'gyangs par 'gyur ro/ /gau ta mī skem mo la bcol du yang gau ta mī skem mo ni 'dul ba 'dzin pa yin la/ de'i 'khor yang 'dul ba 'dzin pa dang ldan pa yin pas de 'di ni ltung ba yin no/ /'di ni ltung ba ma yin no zhes sems pa na dus 'gyangs par 'gyur ro/ /skye dgu'i bdag mo chen mo gau ta mī ni spong ba ma yin la/ 'khor yang spong ba pa dang ldan pas des sems rtse gcig tu 'jog pa la bal rmel ba mi gnod kyis bdag gis de la bal rmel du bcol lo snyam nas/ de de snyam sems zhing 'dug pa na skye dgu'i bdag mo chen mo gau ta mīs bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der 'ongs pa de tshe dang ldan pa 'char kas thag ring po kho na nas mthong nas smras pa/ gau ta mīs bcom ldan 'das kyis tshul khrims dang ldan pa'i sems kyi smon pa 'grub ste/

de yang tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i phyir ro zhes bka' stsal pa de legs par gsungs pa yin te/ da gzod kho na bdag kye ma skye dgu'i bdag mo chen mo gau ta mī 'ongs na ci ma rung snyam pa'i blo skyes na khyod kyang 'dir 'ongs so/ /bdag gis bal nyung zhig rnyed pa de khyed kyis rmel du chug ste byin cig /'phags pa bdag bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal te slar mchis nas dge slong ma gnyis btang gis de gnyis la bskur bar stsol cig /'char kas bal de dag gzar thag gis bam po gnyis su dam du rab tu bcings te sgo glegs kyi phag tu bzhag go/ /de nas skye dgu'i bdag mo chen mo gau ta mī bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal te/ dbyar khang du son nas des de'i gan du dge slong ma gnyis btang ste/ 'phags pa 'char ka'i gan du deng la bal de bskur du stsol zhes gyis shig ces bsgo'o/ /de gnyis dong ste smras pa/ 'phags pa gau ta mī'i mchid nas bal de bskur du gsol zhes mchi'o/ /'char kas de gnyis la smras pa/ sgo glegs kyi phag na bam po gnyis 'dug pa de gnyis khyer la deng shig /de gnyis gnas khang du zhugs te 'degs par brtsams pa dang / bsgul ba tsam du yang ma nus nas de gnyis kyis smras pa/ 'phags pa ci 'dir rang thag gi gor ma dag stsal tam/ gzhon nu ma gnyis ci khyed gnyis gzhon nu ma gta' gam pa yin nam/ zhes des the'u chung gis bteg ste gcig ni gcig gi mgor bskur/ gcig ni gcig gi rked du bskur ro/ /de gnyis mgo chag la thug go/ /rked pa chag la thug go zhes zer zhing dbyar khang du dong nas khur sa la bzhag ste khri steng du sgyel cing 'dug go/ /dge slong ma rnams kyis de gnyis la smras pa/ khyed gnyis gzhon nu ma gta' gam pa yin nam/ de gnyis kyis smras pa/ khyed cag las stobs dang ldan pa gang yin pa des je 'di theg shig /de dag gis de 'degs par brtsams pa dang / bsgul ba tsam du yang ma nus nas de dag gis smras pa/ 'phags ma gnyis ci 'dir rang thag gi rdo dag bcug gam zhes de dag gis bam po de gnyis bshig

pa dang ji tsam na phung po chen por rnam par gnas par gyur to/ /dge slong ma rnams kyis rta gad kyis btab ste smras pa/ 'phags pa 'char ka na re bal cung zhig zer na gal te mang bar gyur na ji lta bur 'gyur/ skye dgu'i bdag mo chen mo gau ta mīs smras pa/ nu mo dag mgo bregs shing mchan khung ral bu can dag yin na god du ci yod/ 'phags pa 'char ka'i mchid nas bal nyung zhig ces mchi na gal te mang bar gyur na ji lta bur 'gyur/ skye dgu'i bdag mo chen mo gau ta mīs smras pa/ nu mo dag de dag ni gnas ngan len kun tu spyod pa dag yin pas de dag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la 'drums pa ltung bas ltung bar byed do/ /nu mo dag bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di gnyis ni skyes bu dam pa yin te/ khur ma blangs pa mi len pa gang yin pa dang / khur blangs pa mthar phyin par byed pa gang yin pa'o zhes gsungs pas/ 'di ni khur blangs pa yin pas mthar phyin par bya dgos kyis/ khyed cag las gang gis ji tsam rmel bar spro ba de tsam rmel la de'i gen du khyer te byin cig /de dag yun ring du thogs pa dang 'char kas bsams pa/ de dag gis bal de bca' ba'i rin du bzhag gor ma chag /bdag gis ma legs pa zhig byas te bdag gis bal de ni char pas 'jigs pas gang la khar bzhag pa dang 'dra bar gyur to snyam mo/ /dge slong ma gnyis kyis bal khal cig rmel te khyer te 'ongs nas smras pa/ 'phags pa 'char ka bal dag 'tshal te mchis na gang du gzhag par bgyi/ 'char kas bsams pa/ da dung spyod yul lhag ma dang bcas pa yin no snyam nas smras pa/ gnas khang du chug ste zhog shig /de gnyis kyis bzhag ste song ba dang / gzhan dag gis kyang khyer te 'ongs so/ /ji tsam na thams cad kyis kyang khyer te 'ongs so/ /de nas skye dgu'i bdag mo chen mo gau ta mī bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal te mtha' gcig tu 'dug go/ /de'i tshe na skye dgu'i bdag mo chen mo gau ta

mī'i lag pa gnyis 'di lta ste/ dper na btso blag mkhan gyi lag pa dmar ba ltar dmar ba dang shin tu dmar bar gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis skye dgu'i bdag mo chen mo gau ta mī la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /gau ta mī ci'i phyir khyod kyi lag pa gnyis 'di lta ste/ dper na btso blag mkhan gyi lag pa dmar ba ltar dmar ba dang shin tu dmar bar gyur/ bcom ldan 'das 'di na bgyi ba gzhan lags na gzhan bgyid do/ /ji ltar gyur/ 'phags pa 'char kas bdag bal rmel du stsal to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo dge slong dag dge slong ma nye du ma yin pa la lug bal dag rmel du 'jud dam/ btsun pa rmel du stsol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byung ba 'di dang / gleng gzhi 'di dang / skabs 'di la dge slong gi dge 'dun bsdu ba mdzad do zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mkhyen bzhin du rmed par mdzad pa ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa yang snga ma bzhin te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka la rmas pa/ 'char ka khyod dge slong ma nye du ma yin pa la lug bal dag rmel du 'jud pa bden nam/ btsun pa mad do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge sbyong gi tshul ma yin pa/ rjes su mthun pa ma yin pa/ rung ba ma yin pa/ tshul dang mthun pa ma yin pa de ni rab tu byung bas bya ba ma yin no zhes rnam par smad pa mdzad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rnam grangs du mas rnam par smad nas dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na phan yon bcu yang dag par gzigs pas 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhi bca' bar bya ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /nga'i nyan thos rnams kyis 'dul ba la bslab pa'i gzhi 'di ltar gdon par bya ste/ yang dge slong gang dge slong ma nye du ma yin pa la lug bal 'khrur 'jud dam/ 'tshed du 'jud dam/ rmel du 'jud na spang ba'i

ltung byed do/ /yang dge slong gang zhes bya ba ni 'char ka'am gzhan yang de lta bu gang yin pa'o/ /dge slong ma zhes bya ba ni chos 'di pa'o/ /nye du ma yin pa la zhes bya ba ni phyi mo dang mes po dang / phrugs kyi bdun pa tshun chad ni nye du yin la/ de phan chad ni nye du ma yin no/ /lug bal zhes bya ba ni lug gi bal lo/ /'khrur 'jud dam zhes bya ba ni tha na chur snyug pa byed du 'jud na'o/ /'tshed du 'jud dam zhes bya ba ni tha na tshon du snyug pa byed du 'jud na'o/ /rmel du 'jud na zhes bya ba ni tha na 'da' ba byed du 'jud na'o/ /spang ba'i ltung byed do zhes bya ba ni dngos po de spangs nas ltung byed kyi ltung ba bshags par bya ba ste/ des na spang ba'i ltung byed do zhes gsungs so/ /de la ltung bar ji ltar 'gyur zhe na/ dge slong gis dge slong ma nye du ma yin pa la nye du ma yin par 'du shes pas lug bal dag 'khrur 'jud na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /'tshed du 'jud na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /rmel du 'jud na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /'khrur 'jud pa dang 'tshed du 'jud dam/ 'khrur 'jud pa dang rmel du 'jud dam/ 'tshed du 'jud pa dang 'khrur 'jud dam/ 'tshed du 'jud pa dang rmel du 'jud dam/ rmel du 'jud pa dang 'khrur 'jud dam/ rmel du 'jud pa dang 'tshed du 'jud dam/ 'khrur 'jud pa dang 'tshed du 'jud pa dang / rmel du 'jud na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis dge slong ma nye du ma yin pa la yid gnyis za bas lug bal dag 'khrur 'jud na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /'tshed du 'jud na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /rmel du 'jud na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /'khrur 'jud pa dang 'tshed du 'jud dam/ 'khrur 'jud pa dang rmel du 'jud dam/ 'tshed du 'jud pa dang 'khrur 'jud dam/ 'tshed du 'jud pa dang rmel du 'jud dam/ rmel du 'jud pa dang 'khrur 'jud dam/ rmel du 'jud pa dang 'tshed du 'jud dam/ 'khrur 'jud pa dang 'tshed du 'jud pa dang / rmel du 'jud na spang

ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis dge slong ma nye du la nye du ma yin par 'du shes pas lug bal dag 'khrur 'jud na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /'tshed du 'jud na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /rmel du 'jud na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /'khrur 'jud pa dang 'tshed du 'jud dam/ 'khrur 'jud pa dang rmel du 'jud dam/ 'tshed du 'jud pa dang 'khrur 'jud dam/ 'tshed du 'jud pa dang rmel du 'jud dam/ rmel du 'jud pa dang 'khrur 'jud dam/ rmel du 'jud pa dang 'tshed du 'jud dam/ 'khrur 'jud pa dang 'tshed du 'jud pa dang / rmel du 'jud na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis dge slong ma nye du la yid gnyis za bas lug bal dag 'khrur 'jud na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /'tshed du 'jud na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /rmel du 'jud na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /'khrur 'jud pa dang 'tshed du 'jud dam/ 'khrur 'jud pa dang rmel du 'jud dam/ 'tshed du 'jud pa dang 'khrur 'jud dam/ 'tshed du 'jud pa dang rmel du 'jud dam/ rmel du 'jud pa dang 'khrur 'jud dam/ rmel du 'jud pa dang 'tshed du 'jud dam/ 'khrur 'jud pa dang 'tshed du 'jud pa dang / rmel du 'jud na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /las dang po pa dang / smyos pa dang / sems 'khrugs pa dang / tshor ba dag gis nyen pa la ltung ba med do/ /bal rmel du 'jud pa'i spang ba ste bcu bdun pa rdzogs s+ho// //sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab na 'od ma'i tshal ka lan da ka'i gnas na bzhugs so/ /de nas grong dpon gtsug na nor bu bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te mtha' gcig tu 'dug go/ /mtha' gcig tu 'dug nas bcom ldan 'das la grong dpon gtsug na nor bus 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa sngon gyi gdugs rnams kyis ches snga ba zhig na rgyal po'i pho brang na rgyal po dang blon po'i 'khor mchis shing mthun par gyur pa rnams la bar skabs kyi bka' mchid kun tu brjod pa 'di lta

bu 'di byung bar gyur te/ shes ldan dag ci dge slong rnams la mngon mtshan can rung ngam/ shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong rnams gser bdag gir bgyid dam/ 'on te dge slong rnams la mngon mtshan can mi rung zhing shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong rnams gser bdag gir mi bgyid ces mchi nas/ de na kha cig ni 'di skad ces dge slong rnams la mngon mtshan can rung zhing shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong rnams gser bdag gir bgyid do zhes mchi/ kha cig ni 'di skad ces dge slong rnams la mngon mtshan can mi rung zhing shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong rnams gser bdag gir mi bgyid do zhes mchi na/ btsun pa de la gang dag de skad ces dge slong rnams la mngon mtshan can rung zhing shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong rnams gser bdag gir bgyid do zhes mchis na/ btsun pa ji ltar gang dag de skad mchi ba de dag de ltar brda sprod par bgyid pa na/ bcom ldan 'das la skur pa 'debs par mi bgyid cing ha cang thal bar yang mi bgyid pa dang / de dag bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i rjes su smra ba dang / chos smra ba dang / chos kyi rjes su mthun pa'i chos brda sprod par bgyid pa dang / gsungs pa'i rjes su smra ba de dag la gzhan las chos dang mthun pas smad pa'i gnas lta bu'i chos 'ga' yang mi mchi ba lags sam/ grong dpon gang dag de skad ces dge slong rnams la mngon mtshan can rung zhing shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong rnams gser bdag gir byed do zhes zer ba de dag de ltar brda sprod par byed pa nang la skur pa 'debs par byed cing ha cang thal bar byed pa dang / de dag ngas smras pa'i rjes su smra ba ma yin pa dang / chos smra ba ma yin pa dang / chos kyi rjes su mthun pa'i chos brda sprod par byed pa ma yin pa dang / smras pa'i rjes su smra ba ma yin pa de dag la gzhan las chos dang mthun pas smad pa'i gnas lta bu'i chos shin tu 'ong ba yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ grong dpon dge slong rnams la mngon mtshan can mi rung zhing shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong rnams

gser bdag gir mi byed de/ gang la la la mngon mtshan can rung zhing gser bdag gir byed pa de ni dge sbyong gi chos ma yin zhing de ni shākya'i sras kyi chos ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /grong dpon ngas khyod la don de nyid kyi phyir lan gnyis lan gsum gyi bar du brjod par bya ste/ dge slong rnams la mngon mtshan can mi rung zhing shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong rnams gser bdag gir mi byed de/ gang la la la mngon mtshan can rung zhing gser bdag gir byed pa de ni dge sbyong gi chos ma yin zhing de ni shākya'i sras kyi chos ma yin no/ /btsun pa gang gi slad du bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces dge slong rnams la mngon mtshan can mi rung zhing shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong rnams gser bdag gir mi bgyid de/ gang la la la mngon mtshan can rung zhing gser bdag gir bgyid pa de ni dge sbyong gi chos ma lags shing de ni shākya'i sras kyi chos ma lags so zhes bka' stsal te/ ji tsam du bcom ldan 'das kyis legs par gsungs pa ni ngo mtshar to/ /btsun pa gang gi slad du bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces grong dpon ngas khyod la don de nyid kyi phyir lan gnyis lan gsum gyi bar du brjod par bya ste/ dge slong rnams la mngon mtshan can mi rung zhing shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong rnams gser bdag gir mi bgyid de/ gang la la la mngon mtshan can rung zhing gser bdag gir bgyid pa de ni dge sbyong gi chos ma lags shing de ni shākya'i sras kyi chos ma lags so zhes bka' stsal pa'i bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' de ni rgya cher bzang ba lags so/ /btsun pa bdag kyang 'di snyam bgyid de/ dge slong rnams la mngon mtshan can mi rung zhing shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong rnams gser bdag gir mi bgyid de/ gang la la la mngon mtshan can rung zhing gser bdag gir bgyid pa de ni 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga po dag kyang rung ba kho na lags so/ /grong dpon de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ dge slong rnams la mngon mtshan can mi rung zhing shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong rnams gser bdag gir mi byed de/ gang la la la mngon mtshan can rung

zhing gser bdag gir byed pa de ni dge sbyong gi chos ma yin zhing de ni shākya'i sras kyi chos ma yin no/ /de nas grong dpon gtsug na nor bus bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa la mngon par dga' ba dang rjes su yi rang ba byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nas song ngo / /de'i tshe na tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo bcom ldan 'das kyi snam logs na 'dug par gyur cing bsil yab thogs te bcom ldan 'das la g.yob cing 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis grong dpon gtsug na nor bu song nas ring por ma lon par thugs su chud nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo song la 'od ma'i tshal ka lan da ka'i gnas na dge slong ji snyed nye bar rten cing gnas pa de dag thams cad dpong sa'i khang par bsdus shig /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes bcom ldan 'das las mnyan nas 'od ma'i tshal ka lan da ka'i gnas na dge slong ji snyed nye bar rten cing gnas pa de dag thams cad dpong sa'i khang par bsdus te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal te mtha' gcig tu 'dug go/ /mtha' gcig tu 'dug nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa 'od ma'i tshal ka lan da ka'i gnas na dge slong ji snyed nye bar rten cing gnas pa de dag thams cad dpong sa'i khang par mchis shing mthun par gyur na bcom ldan 'das kyis da de'i dus la bab par mkhyen par mdzad du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das dpong sa'i khang pa ga la ba der gshegs te byon nas dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gong du gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /bzhugs nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag da ci'i grong dpon gtsug na nor bu nga ga la ba der 'ongs te phyin nas nga'i rkang pa gnyis la phyag 'tshal te mtha' gcig

tu 'dug go/ /mtha' gcig tu 'dug nas nga la grong dpon gtsug na nor bu 'di skad ces btsun pa sngon gyi gdugs rnams kyi ches snga ba zhig na rgyal po'i pho brang na rgyal po dang blon po'i 'khor mchis shing mthun par gyur pa rnams la bar skabs kyi bka' mchid kun tu rjod pa 'di lta bu 'di byung bar gyur te/ shes ldan dag ci dge slong rnams la mngon mtshan can rung ngam shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong rnams gser bdag gir bgyid dam/ 'on te dge slong rnams la mngon mtshan can mi rung zhing shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong rnams gser bdag gir mi bgyid ces mchi nas/ de na kha cig ni 'di skad ces dge slong rnams la mngon mtshan can rung zhing shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong rnams gser bdag gir bgyid do zhes mchi/ kha cig ni 'di skad ces dge slong rnams la mngon mtshan can mi rung zhing shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong rnams gser bdag gir mi bgyid do zhes mchi na/ btsun pa de la gang dag de skad ces dge slong rnams la mngon mtshan can mi rung zhing shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong rnams gser bdag gir bgyid do zhes mchi na/ btsun pa ji ltar gang dag de skad mchi ba de dag de ltar brda sprod par bgyid pa na bcom ldan 'das la skur pa 'debs par mi bgyid cing ha cang thal bar yang mi bgyid pa dang / de dag bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i rjes su smra ba dang / chos smra ba dang / chos kyi rjes su mthun pa'i chos brda sprod par bgyid pa dang / gsungs pa'i rjes su smra ba pa de dag la gzhan las chos dang mthun pas smad pa'i gnas lta bu'i chos 'ga' yang mi mchi ba lags sam zhes zer nas/ ngas de la 'di skad ces grong dpon gang dag de skad ces dge slong rnams la mngon mtshan can rung zhing shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong rnams gser bdag gir byed do zhes zer ba de dag de ltar brda sprod par byed pa na nga la skur pa 'debs par byed cing ha cang thal bar byed pa dang / de dag ngas smras pa'i rjes su smra ba ma yin pa dang / chos smra ba ma yin pa dang / chos kyi rjes su mthun pa'i chos brda sprod par

byed pa ma yin pa dang / smras pa'i rjes su smra ba ma yin pa de dag la gzhan las chos dang mthun pas smad pa'i gnas lta bu'i chos shin tu 'ong ba yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ grong dpon dge slong rnams la mngon mtshan can mi rung zhing shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong rnams gser bdag gir byed de/ gang la la la mngon mtshan can rung zhing gser bdag gir byed pa de ni dge sbyong gi chos ma yin zhing de ni shākya'i sras kyi chos ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /grong dpon ngas khyod la don de nyid kyi phyir lan gnyis lan gsum gyi bar du brjod par bya ste/ dge slong rnams la mngon mtshan can mi rung zhing shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong rnams gser bdag gir mi byed de/ gang la la la mngon mtshan can rung zhing gser bdag gir byed pa de ni dge sbyong gi chos ma yin zhing de ni shākya'i sras kyi chos ma yin no zhes smras pa dang / deng la 'di skad ces btsun pa gang gi slad du bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces dge slong rnams la mngon mtshan can mi rung zhing shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong rnams gser bdag gir mi bgyid de/ gang la la la mngon mtshan can rung zhing gser bdag gir bgyid pa de ni dge sbyong gi chos ma lags shing de ni shākya'i sras kyi chos ma lags so zhes bka' stsal te/ ji tsam du bcom ldan 'das kyis legs par gsungs pa ni ngo mtshar to/ /btsun pa gang gis slad du bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces grong dpon ngas khyod la don de nyid kyi phyir lan gnyis lan gsum gyi bar du brjod par bya ste/ dge slong rnams la mngon mtshan can mi rung zhing shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong rnams gser bdag gir mi bgyid de/ gang la la la mngon mtshan can rung zhing gser bdag gir bgyid pa de ni dge sbyong gi chos ma lags shing de ni shākya'i sras kyi chos ma lags so/ /zhes bka' stsal pa'i bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' de ni rgya cher bzang ba lags so/ /btsun pa bdag kyang 'di snyam bgyid de/ dge slong rnams la mngon mtshan can mi rung zhing shākya'i

sras kyi dge sbyong rnams gser bdag gir mi bgyid de/ gang la la la mngon mtshan can rung zhing gser bdag gir bgyid pa de la ni 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga po dag kyang rung ba kho na lags so zhes zer ro/ /ngas de la 'di skad ces grong dpon de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ dge slong rnams la mngon mtshan can mi rung zhing shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong rnams gser bdag gir mi bgyid do/ /gang la la la mngon mtshan can rung zhing gser bdag gir byed pa de ni dge sbyong gi chos ma yin zhing de ni shākya'i sras kyi chos ma yin no zhes smras so/ /de nas grong dpon gtsug na nor bu des ngas smras pa la mngon par dga' ba dang / rjes su yi rang ba byas nas nga'i rkang pa gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te nga'i drung nas song ngo / /dge slong dag de ltar grong dpon gtsug na nor bu des rgyal po dang bcas pa'i 'khor gyi mdun du dge slong rnams la mngon mtshan can mi rung zhing shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong rnams gser bdag gir mi byed de/ gang la la la mngon mtshan can rung zhing gser bdag gir byed pa de la ni 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga po dag kyang gdon mi za bar rung ba yin no zhes cha gcig bzung ste/ khyu mchog gi tshig rgya chen po smras shing 'khor gyi nang du yang dag par seng ge'i sgra bsgrags so/ /dge slong dag ngas kyang de skad ces dge slong rnams la mngon mtshan can mi rung zhing shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong rnams gser bdag gir mi byed de/ gang la la la mngon mtshan can rung zhing gser bdag gir byed pa de ni dge sbyong gi chos ma yin zhing de ni shākya'i sras kyi chos ma yin no zhes smras so/ /dge slong dag de lta bas na khyed kyis da deng phyin cad shing 'dod pa dag gis shing yongs su btsal bar bya/ rtswa 'dod pa dag gis ni rtswa/ shing rta'i las 'dod pa dag gis ni shing rta'i las/ mi blas 'dod pa dag gis ni mi blas yongs su btsal bar bya zhes smra ba'i 'di skad ces rnam grangs gang gis kyang gser bdag gir bya ba ni mi smra'o/ /'di ni re zhig byung ba yin

gyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das re zhig 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhi 'cha' bar ni mi mdzad do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe na dge slong drug sde dag rang gi lag gis gser dang dngul len par byed/ len du 'jud par byed/ phung po gcig tu byed/ phung po gnyis su byed/ khri dang khri'u dang / khri'u chung ngu dag tu 'jog par byed nas/ gzhan mu stegs can dag shes ldan dag shākya'i bu'i dge sbyong dag ni ma log ma spangs so sor ma spangs pa yin te/ 'di ltar rang gi lag gis gser dang dngul len par byed/ len du 'jud par byed/ phung po gcig tu byed/ phung po gnyis su byed/ khri dang khri'u dang / khri'u chung ngu dag tu 'jog par byed do/ /bram ze dang khyim bdag dag kyang rang gi lag gis gser dang dngul len par byed/ len du 'jud par byed/ phung po gcig tu byed/ phung po gnyis su byed/ khri dang khri'u dang / khri'u chung ngu dag 'jog par byed na shes ldan dag shākya'i bu'i dge sbyong rnams dang bram ze dang / khyim bdag rnams kyi 'di la bye brag ni ci yod/ bsam pa ni ci yod/ tha dad du bya ba ni ci yod/ su zhig dge sbyong mgo reg 'di dag la bsod snyoms sbyin pa dang bya bar sems zhes smod par byed/ phyar ka gtong bar byed/ kha zer bar byed pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byung ba 'di dang / gleng gzhi 'di dang / skabs 'di la dge slong gi dge 'dun bsdu ba mdzad do zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mkhyen bzhin du rmed par mdzad pa ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa yang snga ma bzhin te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong drug sde dag la rmas pa/ dge slong dag khyed rang gi lag gis gser dang dngul len pa dang / len du

'jud par byed pa bden nam/ btsun pa mad do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge sbyong gi tshul ma yin pa dang / rjes su mthun pa ma yin pa/ rung ba ma yin pa/ tshul dang mthun pa ma yin pa de ni rab tu byung bas bya ba ma yin no zhes rnam par smad par mdzad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rnam grangs du mas rnam par smad nas dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na phan yon bcu yang dag par gzigs pas 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhi bca' bar bya ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /nga'i nyan thos rnams kyis 'dul ba la bslab pa'i gzhi 'di ltar gdon par bya ste/ yang dge slong gang rang gi lag gis gser dang dngul len tam/ len du 'jud na spang ba'i ltung byed do/ /yang dge slong gang zhes bya ba ni drug ste dag gam gzhan yang de lta bu gang yin pa'o/ /rang gi lag gis zhes bya ba ni rang gi lag pas so/ /gser dang dngul zhes bya ba ni dbyig dang gser ro/ /len tam zhes bya ba ni bdag nyid kyis so/ /len du 'jug na zhes bya ba ni gzhan no/ /spang ba'i ltung byed do zhes bya ba ni dngos po de spangs nas ltung byed kyi ltung ba bshags par bya ba ste/ des na spang ba'i ltung byed do zhes gsungs so/ /de la ltung bar ji ltar 'gyur zhe na/ gzhi bcwa brgyad kyis te/ 'di long shig /'di nas long shig /'di tsam long shig ces bya ba dang / 'di khyer shog /'di nas khyer shog /'di tsam khyer shog ces bya ba dang / 'di zhog shig /'dir zhog shig /'di tsam zhog shig ces bya ba dang / de long shig de nas long shig /de tsam long shig ces bya ba dang / de khyer shog /de nas khyer shog /de tsam khyer shog ces bya ba dang / de zhog shig /der zhog shig /de tsam zhog shig ces bya bas so/ /de la 'di long shig ces bya ba ni 'thob par 'gyur ba'i phyogs su dbyig gam/ gser 'di long shig ces bsgo bar byed pa ste/ de bsgo bar byed pa la nyes byas su 'gyur la/ blangs pa na spang ba'i

ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /'di nas long shig ces bya ba ni 'thob par 'gyur ba'i phyogs su zangs po che nas sam/ zangs nas sam/ rdza bo nas sam/ sgrom nas sam/ ko lpags nas sam/ za ma tog nas long shig ces bsgo bar byed pa ste/ de bsgo bar byed pa la nyes byas su 'gyur la/ blangs pa na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /'di tsam long shig ces bya ba ni 'thob par 'gyur ba'i phyogs su brgya'am/ stong ngam 'bum long shig ces bsgo bar byed pa ste/ de bsgo bar byed pa la nyes byas su 'gyur la/ blangs pa na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /'di khyer shog ces bya ba ni 'thob par 'gyur ba'i phyogs su dbyig gam/ gser 'di khyer shog ces bsgo bar byed pa ste/ de bsgo bar byed pa la nyes byas su 'gyur la/ khyer ba na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /'di nas khyer shog ces bya ba ni 'thob par 'gyur ba'i phyogs su zangs po che nas sam/ zangs nas sam/ rdza bo nas sam/ sgrom nas sam/ ko lpags nas sam/ za ma tog nas khyer shog ces bsgo bar byed pa ste/ de bsgo bar byed pa la nyes byas su 'gyur la/ blangs pa na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /'di tsam khyer shog ces bya ba ni 'thob par 'gyur ba'i phyogs su brgya'am/ stong ngam/ 'bum khyer shog ces bsgo bar byed pa ste/ de bsgo bar byed pa la nyes byas su 'gyur la/ khyer ba na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /'di zhog shig ces bya ba ni 'thob par 'gyur ba'i phyogs su dbyig gam/ gser 'di zhog shig ces bsgo bar byed pa ste/ de bsgo bar byed pa la nyes byas su 'gyur la/ bzhag pa na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /'dir zhog shig ces bya ba ni 'thob par 'gyur ba'i phyogs su zangs po cher ram/ zangs su'am/ rdza phor ram/ sgrom du'am/ ko lpags su'am/ za ma tog tu zhog shig ces bsgo bar byed pa ste/ de bsgo bar byed pa la nyes byas su 'gyur la/ bzhag pa na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /'di tsam

zhog shig ces bya ba ni 'thob par 'gyur ba'i phyogs su brgya'am/ stong ngam/ 'bum zhog shig ces bsgo bar byed pa ste/ de bsgo bar byed pa la nyes byas su 'gyur la/ bzhag pa na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /de long shig ces bya ba ni 'thob par 'gyur ba'i phyogs su dbyig gam/ gser de long shig ces bsgo bar byed pa ste/ de bsgo bar byed pa la nyes byas su 'gyur la/ blangs pa na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /de nas long shig ces bya ba ni 'thob par 'gyur ba'i phyogs su zangs po che nas sam/ zangs nas sam/ rdza bo nas sam/ sgrom nas sam/ ko lpags nas sam/ za ma tog nas long shig ces bsgo bar byed pa ste/ de bsgo bar byed pa la nyes byas su 'gyur la/ blangs pa na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /de tsam long shig ces bya ba ni 'thob par 'gyur ba'i phyogs su brgya'am/ stong ngam/ 'bum long shig ces bsgo bar byed pa ste de bsgo bar byed pa la nyes byas su 'gyur la/ blangs pa na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /de khyer shog ces bya ba ni 'thob par 'gyur ba'i phyogs su dbyig gam/ gser de khyer shog ces bsgo bar byed pa ste de bsgo bar byed pa la nyes byas su 'gyur la/ khyer ba na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /de nas khyer shog ces bya ba ni 'thob par 'gyur ba'i phyogs su zangs po che nas sam/ zangs nas sam/ rdza bo nas sam/ sgrom nas sam/ ko lpags nas sam/ za ma tog nas khyer shog ces bsgo bar byed pa ste de bsgo bar byed pa la nyes byas su 'gyur la/ blangs pa na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /de tsam khyer shog ces bya ba ni 'thob par 'gyur ba'i phyogs su brgya 'am/ stong ngam/ 'bum khyer shog ces bsgo bar byed pa ste de bsgo bar byed pa la nyes byas su 'gyur la/ khyer ba na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /de zhog shig ces bya ba ni 'thob par 'gyur ba'i phyogs su dbyig gam/ gser de zhog shig ces bsgo bar byed pa ste de bsgo bar byed pa la nyes byas su 'gyur la/ bzhag pa na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /der zhog shig ces bya ba ni 'thob

par 'gyur ba'i phyogs su zangs po cher ram/ zangs su'am/ rdza phor ram/ sgrom du'am/ ko lpags su'am/ za ma tog tu zhog shig ces bsgo bar byed pa ste/ de bsgo bar byed pa la nyes byas su 'gyur la/ bzhag pa na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /de tsam zhog shig ces bya ba ni 'thob par 'gyur ba'i phyogs su brgya 'am/ stong ngam/ 'bum zhog shig ces bsgo bar byed pa ste de bsgo bar byed pa la nyes byas su 'gyur la/ bzhag pa na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /'di long shig /'di nas long shig 'di tsam long shig ces bya ba dang / 'di khyer shog 'di nas khyer shog /'di tsam khyer shog ces bya ba dang / 'di zhog shig 'dir zhog shig /'di tsam zhog shig ces bya ba dang / de long shig de nas long shig /de tsam long shig ces bya ba dang / de khyer shog de nas khyer shog /de tsam khyer shog ces bya ba dang / de zhog shig der zhog shig /de tsam zhog shig ces bya ba de dag 'thob par 'gyur ba ma yin pa'i phyogs su bsgo bar byed na/ de bsgo bar byed pa la nyes byas su 'gyur la/ blangs pa dang khyer ba dang / bzhag pa na yang nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis dbyig la reg na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /gser la reg na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dbyig dang gser la reg na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis dbyig gam/ gser brdungs pa la reg na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dbyig dang gser mngon mtshan can la reg na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dngul la reg na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /nor bu la reg na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /mu tig la reg na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /bai ḍūr+ya la reg na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /nor bu dang mu tig dang bai ḍūr+ya la reg na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis yul gyi tha snyad can gyi dbyig dang / gser la reg na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /ra gan dang zangs ma dang / lcags dang rno lcags dang ro nye dang

zha nye dang / khro chu la reg pa la ltung ba med do zhes de ltar bcom ldan 'das 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhi bca' ba mdzad do// //'dul ba rnam par 'byed pa/ bam po sum bcu rtsa gsum pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe na tsam pa na khyim bdag dad pa dang ldan pa/ dge ba'i bsam pa can/ bzang po sbyin pa zhig 'dug pa des de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos kyi dge 'dun gyi phyir gtsug lag khang rta babs mthon po dang / skar khung dang skar khung dra ba can dang / lan kan gyis brgyan pa/ snying dang mig 'phrog pa mtho ris kyi them skas su gyur pa zhig byed du bcug nas/ der dge slong mang po dag dbyar gnas par khas blangs te/ de dag gis dgag dbye byas nas smras pa/ khyim bdag bdag cag mnyan yod du ston pa dang / dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan rnams kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal du 'gros bdag cag la gos dag byin cig /khyim bdag des smras pa/ 'phags pa dag 'di na gos bzang po dag ma mchis te/ don mthun dag mchi zhes grag gis don mthun dag mchis kyi bar du re zhig gzhes shig dang / de nas gos bzang po dag 'jal te gsol lo/ /de dag gis smras pa/ khyim bdag gal te gos bzang po dag med na gos ngan pa dag byin cig /'phags pa dag bdag ni bzang po sbyin pa lags na/ ji ltar bdag gis ngan pa dag gsol bar bgyi/ gal te khyed cag rings na gos kyi rin kār ṣā pa ṇa dag snoms la bzhud cig /khyim bdag bcom ldan 'das kyis kār ṣā pa ṇa dag bkag pas bdag cag mi len to/ /'phags pa dag 'di ltar bdag la ma byin pa ni mi mnga'i/ gos ngan pa dag sbyin du ni mi rung ngo / /dge slong de dag gis kār ṣā pa ṇa dag ma blangs par gos ngan pa dag kho nas dong ste/ mthar gyis mnyan yod du phyin pa dang / de dag la dge slong rnams kyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag khyed cag gis dbyar gnas pa'i gos kyi rnyed pa ma rnyed dam/

ci nas gang gi phyir khyed cag gos dag ngan par gyur ma rnyed do/ /khyed cag gang du dbyar gnas par khas blangs tsam par ro/ /khyim bdag gang la brten/ che ge mo zhig la'o/ /khyim bdag de bzang po sbyin pa zhes grag go de'i phyir ma rnyed do/ /ci'i phyir de dag gis skabs de rgyas par brjod pa dang / dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'di snyam du dgongs te/ kye ma bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can dag kyang gos kyi rin dag sbyin par byed la/ nga'i nyan thos rnams kyang gos kyi rin dag 'dod kyis ngas nyan thos rnams la rung bar bya bar chung zhig gnang bar bya'o snyam du dgongs nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ blang bar bya zhing blangs nas kyang sbyin bdag de nyid la yid brten te bcang bar bya'o/ /gzhan yang dge slong gis zhal ta byed pa spro bar bya'o/ /dge slong dag gis zhal ta byed pa gang spro bar bya ba mi shes nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' ra ba pa'am/ dge bsnyen spro bar bya ste/ kun dga' ra ba pa zhes bya ba ni rung ba byed pa'o/ /dge bsnyen zhes bya ba ni gsum la skyabs su song ba bslab pa'i gzhi lnga bzung ba'o/ /dge slong dag yul gzhan du 'dong ba na de dag 'di na bdag cag la sbyin bdag 'ga' yang med do zhes 'gyod pa skyes pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sbyin bdag de nyid ji srid du son pa dang / 'dug pa dang / 'tsho ba dang / sdod pa'i bar du shin tu ring du song yang nyams pa med do/ /dge slong rnams kyis chos gos kyi rin dag rnyed la sbyin bdag med nas de dag 'gyod pa skyes te/ mi len pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ blang bar bya zhing blangs nas kyang dge slong gi mdun du 'greng ste 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa dgongs su gsol/ bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dngos po rung ba ma lags pa 'di rnyed de/ bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dngos po rung ba ma lags pa 'di byin gyis

brlab bo/ /dngos po rung ba ma lags pa 'dis dngos po rung ba bsgrub par bgyi'o/ /de bzhin du lan gnyis lan gsum du brjod par bya ste/ 'di la 'gyod par mi bya'o/ /bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can dag gis mtha' 'khob dag tu gtsug lag khang dag byed du bcug nas de na dus dang dus su skrag pa dag byung nas dge slong dag gis gtsug lag khang stong par bor te byer ro ma byin par len pa dag gis gtsug lag khang stong par rig nas gtsug lag khang bcom pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge 'dun bye'am/ mchod rten gyi dbyig dang gser sbas te 'gro bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis sba bar bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / de dag gis gang gis sba bar bya ba mi shes nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' ra ba pa'am/ dge bsnyen gyis sba bar bya'o/ /gang dag sbed par byed pa de dag nyid rku bar byed nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge bsnyen dad pa can gyis sba bar bya'o/ /dge bsnyen dad pa can med na dge tshul gyis sba bar bya'o/ /dge tshul med na dge slong dag gis rang gis sba bar bya'o/ /de la dong brko bar bya ba yod nas gang gis brko bar bya ba mi shes nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' ra ba pa'am/ dge bsnyen gyis brko bar bya'o/ /de nyid rku bar byed nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge bsnyen dad pa can gyis brko bar bya'o/ /dge bsnyen dad pa can med na dge tshul gyis brko bar bya'o/ /dge tshul med na dge slong dag gis rang gis brko bar bya'o/ /'jigs pa dang bral na rnam pa de lta bu nyid kyis phyung ste dge 'dun la dbul bar bya'o/ /dge slong dag ngas phongs pa'i dus dag tu gnang ba gang yin pa de bde ba'i gnas skabs dag tu spyad par mi bya ste/ spyod na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /las dang po pa dang / smyos pa dang / sems 'khrugs pa dang / tshor ba dag gis nyen pa la ltung ba med do/ /gser dngul la reg pa'i spang ba ste bcwa brgyad pa rdzogs s+ho// //sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /gang gi tshe bcom ldan

'das 'jig rten du byung ba de'i tshe na thams cad du yul dbus su sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das byung ngo zhes sgra grags te/ de'i nyan thos rnams 'bar ba dang / gsal ba dang / char 'bab pa dang / glog 'byin pa'i cho 'phrul dag byed pas gang dag de la mchod pa dag byed pa de dag ni shin tu 'bras bu che ba dang / phan yon che ba dang / gsal ba che ba dang / rgyas pa che bar 'gyur ro zhes byang lam pa'i tshong pa dag gis thos nas de dag gis smras pa/ shes ldan dag yul dbus su 'dong ngo / /der khe spogs mang po yang bsgrub par bya/ sangs rgyas dang / chos dang dge 'dun dag la mchod pa bya'o zhes byang lam pa'i tshong pa de dag zong thogs te/ yul dbus su 'phags nas mthar gyis mnyan yod du phyin to/ /mnyan yod na shes pa can rtsis mkhas pa zhig 'dug pa des byang lam nas tshong pa don mthun 'ongs zhes thos nas des bsams pa/ song ste je bltas na der cung zad 'thob po snyam nas/ des cung zad dmigs pas kyang shes/ cung zad rtog ges kyang shes nas de song ste/ ded dpon la ming dang rus nas brjod cing ming 'di zhes bya ba 'ongs pa legs so 'ongs pa legs so/ /khyod kyi ma ni ming 'di zhes bya/ khyod kyi pha ni ming 'di zhes bya/ khyod kyi rdzas ni 'di snyed cig 'ongs so/ /nyi ma ga ge mo zhig la ni khal 'jig par 'gyur ro/ /khe spogs ni 'di snyed cig 'grub par 'gyur ro zhes smras pa dang ded dpon des bsams pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos gang dag 'bar ba dang / gsal ba dang / char 'bab pa dang / glog 'byin pa'i cho 'phrul dag byed ces grag pa de dag las 'ga' zhig 'di yin gor ma chag snyam nas des de la dad pas byang lam gyi nags kyi 'bras bus slong phor bkang ste byin nas la ba srin bu'i mdog lta bu cig kyang bskon no/ /shes pa can des blangs shing gyon te tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams kyi gan du song ba dang / de dag gis de mthong nas smras pa/ shes pa can khyod kyis mgo bzlog ste nyal ba gang zhig las thob des

smras pa/ byang lam nas tshong pa don mthun 'ongs nas der kho bos ded dpon la ming dang rus nas brjod nas des kho bo la dad pas dad pa'i dbang du byas pa sbyin no/ /de dag gis smras pa/ shes pa can bdag cag la shākya'i bu'i dge sbyong de dag rtag tu khyed la thag pa dag dang phreng rgyud dag dang / 'bru mar mkhan dag las gzhan pa mi gtso bo 'ga' yang mngon par dad par mi byed do zhes tho 'tsham par byed kyis/ khyod la ba 'di gyon te song la shākya'i bu'i dge sbyong de dag gi snying dag gas par gyis shig de ltar bya'o zhes smras te/ de nas shes pa can de la ba de gyon nas rgyal byed kyi tshal du song ngo / /drug sde dag gis kun tu spyod pa ni 'dir bdag cag gis bram ze dang khyim bdag 'ongs pa rnams la yang chos bstan par bya/ rgol ba dag kyang tshar gcad par bya/ rang gi grags pa yang bsgrag par bya'o snyam pas drug sde las gang yang rung bas rgyal byed kyi tshal gyi sgo stong par mi 'jog pas nye dga' rgyal byed kyi tshal gyi sgo na 'chag cing 'dug pa des shes pa can de thag ring po kho na nas mthong ngo / /de nas nye dga'as bsams pa/ gcer bu pa ngan pa 'di la ba bzang po zhig gyon te 'ongs kyis gal te bdag gis de ma phrogs na nye dga' zhes bya ba'i ming mi gzung ngo snyam nas/ des de la smras pa/ shes pa can khyod gcer bu pa yin la la ba 'di lta bu gyon na phyir babs sam ci kho bo phyir ma babs te/ 'di ltar byang lam nas tshong pa don mthun 'ongs nas der kho bos ded dpon la ming dang rus nas brjod nas des kho bo la dad pas dad pa'i dbang du byas pa byin no/ /ma legs so ma legs so/ /khyed kyis rgas pa'i gnas skabs su tshul khrims 'chal pa kun tu spyad do/ /tshur shog 'dug shig dang chos bstan par bya'o/ /shes pa can de nye dga'i mdun du 'dug pa dang / nye dga' yid dga' zhing yid dga' nas de la sbyin pa'i bsngags pa brjod par brtsams so/ /drug sde dag gi kun tu spyod pa ni gal te tshul khrims kyi gtam dag byed na nyan pa po dag bdag cag lha rnams su skyes so snyam du sems la/ gal te sbyin pa'i gtam dag byed na nyan pa po dag rang gi sha gang yin

pa de yang bcad cing bcad cing sbyin par bya'o snyam du sems so/ /gal te ngan song gi gtam dag byed na nyan pa po dag bdag cag ngan song rnams su skyes so snyam du sems par 'gyur ba yin pas/ nye dga'as shes pa can de la smras pa/ shes pa can khyod kyi ston pa ni ngan pa la mos pa yin te/ gal te de bzang po 'dod par gyur na des khyed cag la gos 'bum ri ba dang / zas ro brgya dang ldan pa dang / khang pa brtsegs pa mig lnga brgya pa yang gnang bar 'gyur ba zhig ma gnang ngo / /kho bo cag gi ston pa ni bzang po la mos pa yin pas/ des kho bo cag la gos 'bum ri ba dang / zas ro brgya dang ldan pa dang / khang pa brtsegs pa mig lnga brgya pa yang gnang ngo / /gal te khyod la ba 'di lta bu gyon te slong mo la 'gro bar gyur na bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can dag gis shes pa can 'dis tshul khrims 'chal pa kun tu spyad do snyam du shes pas khyed kyis slong mo yang mi rnyed par gyur gyis/ khyod kyi la ba 'di kho bo la byin cig dang / kho bos khyod la la ba gzhan zhig sbyin no/ /kho bo la ba 'di gyon te bsod snyoms la 'jug pa na/ bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can dag gis kho bo mthong nas btsun pa nye dga'as la ba 'di lta bu ga las rnyed ces zer na/ kho bos de dag la 'di skad ces shes pa can che ge mo zhig gis byin no zhes brjod par bya ste/ des na de dag gis shes pa can dad pa dang ldan par gyur to snyam du shes par 'gyur zhing / de dag gis khyod slong mo la zhugs pa la chang dang nur rtsi'i slong phor bkang ste sbyin par 'gyur ro/ /des smras pa/ btsun pa nye dga' bzhes shig /nye dga'as smras pa/ shes pa can khyod kyi tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa dag ni tshul khrims 'chal pa yin pas/ khyod de dag gi tshig thos nas yang phyir 'phrog tu 'ong bar gyur pa de lta bu'i gnas yod do/ /btsun pa nye dga' ci kho bo'i la ba 'di tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa de dag dbang ba yin nam/ la

ba 'di ni kho bo nyid dbang ba yin gyis bzhes shig dang / slar 'phrog tu mi mchis so/ /nye dga'as la ba de blangs nas la ba rtsub po gzhan zhig de la byin nas shes pa can de la ba rtsub po de gyon nas tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams kyi gan du phyir song ba dang / de dag gis de mthong nas smras pa/ shes pa can khyod kyis yang mgo bsgyur de nyal ba gang zhig las thob/ des smras pa/ 'di ni glo gzhan nas grub pa yin no/ /ji ltar gyur/ kho bos la ba de btsun pa nye dga' la byin nas des kyang kho bo la la ba 'di byin no/ /de dag gis spyos te smras pa/ shes pa can shākya'i bu'i dge sbyong rnams ni yu bu cag gson pas kyang mi dga' ba yin no/ /drug sde dag ji lta bar gzhan de lta ma yin la/ nye dga' ji lta bar drug sde gzhan de lta ma yin no/ /gal te khyod kyis dge slong gnas brtan gzhan 'ga' zhig la byin par gyur na kho bo cag kyang rjes su yi rang bar byed na khyod kyis nye dga' la byin te/ de ni bdag cag las zong gis kyang khrag gi phyis bu len par 'dod pa yin gyis/ gal te la ba khyer te 'ong na de lta na legs/ gal te khyer te mi 'ong na kho bo cag gis khyod tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa'i nang nas gnas nas dbyung bar bya zhing / tshul shing yang dbyung bar bya/ spang leb khri'u yang bsgyur bar bya/ slong phor yang khas dbub par bya/ khar ba yang dor bar bya'o/ /de skrag nas nye dga' ga la ba der song ba dang nye dga'as thag ring po kho na nas de 'ong ba mthong nas des bsams pa/ shes pa can 'gros 'di lta bus 'ong ba 'di ni bdag gi la ba 'phrog par byed pa yin no snyam nas de gtsug lag khang gi nang du zhugs nas sgo bcad de 'dug go/ /shes pa can des sgo brdung bar brtsams te btsun pa nye dga' btsun pa nye dga' zhes bos pa dang nye dga' cang mi smra bar 'dug go/ /dge slong rnams kyis de la smras pa/ shes pa can khyod la btsun pa nye dga'as ci bya/ des smras pa/ des kho bo'i la ba zhig khyer ro/ /shes pa can gal te khyod la ba 'dod na song la bcom ldan 'das la skyabs su sgrubs shig /de bcom ldan 'das ga la

ba der song ba dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis shes pa can de thag ring po kho na nas 'ong ba gzigs so/ /gzigs nas kyang dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag khyed shes pa can thag ring po kho na nas 'ong ba la ltos shig /btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal/ 'di ni la ba'i phyir 'ongs te/ gal te la ba thob na de lta na legs gal te ma thob na khrag tshab skyugs te dus byed par 'gyur ro/ /de nas shes pa can de phyin nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das btsun pa nye dga'as bdag gi la ba 'tshal ba de bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag la slar stsal du gsol cig /gal te bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag la la ba slar stsal du ma stsal na/ 'di ltar bdag tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa'i nang nas gnas nas phyung bar 'gyur zhing tshul shing yang phyung bar gyur/ spang leb khri'u yang bsgyur bar 'gyur/ slong phor yang khas phub par 'gyur/ khar ba yang bor bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo song la nye dga'i gan du song ste/ shes pa can gyi la ba phyir byin cig /gal te mi byin na shes pa can 'di khrag tsha ba skyugs te dus byed par 'gyur ba'i gnas de lta bu yod do zhes gyis shig /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes bcom ldan 'das las mnyan nas nye dga' ga la ba der song ba dang / nye dga'as tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo thag ring po kho na nas 'ong ba mthong nas des bsams pa/ shes pa can gyi pho nya 'di lta bu khrid de 'ongs pas 'dis kho bo'i la ba phrogs par 'gyur ro snyam mo/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos nye dga' la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ shes pa can gyi la ba phyir byin cig /gal te 'di'i la ba phyir myur bar ma byin na shes pa can 'di khrag tsha ba skyugs te dus byed par 'gyur ba'i gnas de lta bu yod par 'gyur ro zhes byung ngo / /nye dga'as smras pa/ btsun pa kun

dga' bo ston pa'i bka' mnyan par zad kyi/ gzhan du na sgre byi gcer bu 'di khrag tsha ba skyugs te dus byed par 'gyur ba bas gal te shes pa can sha stag gis 'dzam bu'i gling 'di lta ste/ dper na bu ram shing gi tshal lam/ 'dam bu'i tshal lam/ 'od ma'i tshal bzhin du gang bar gyur la de dag thams cad khrag tsha ba skyugs te kha dag cing dus byed par gyur kyang nye dga'i spu'i rtse mo tsam yang mi g.yo ste/ 'on kyang bzhud cig dang sbyin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo song ba dang nye dga'as smras pa/ kwa'i gcer bu pa nyon cig khyod kyis ston pa brdzun ma des brdzun du smra bas 'jig rten bslus nas sems can dmyal ba rnams su skyes te/ de'i lce la thong gshol lnga brgyas rmed par byed na/ khyed kyang de bas kyang brdzun ma chen po yin pas khyed kyi lce la yang thong gshol stong gis rmo bar 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang kho bo'i la ba khyod kyis spyod na/ ci kho bos kyang khyod kyi la ba spyad snyam mam/ btsun pa nye dga' ma lags so/ /nye dga'as de'i la ba des mdoms kyi phyogs thams cad phyis nas bzhi ltab tu bltab ste/ lag pa g.yon pa'i steng du bzhag nas lag pa g.yas pas thal lcag gis bsnun pa dang rim pa thams cad rdol bar gyur nas smras pa/ shes pa can lag pa gnyis rkyong shig /des lag pa gnyis brkyang ba dang / nye dga'as gang gis de khas bub tu 'gyel bar 'gyur ba de lta bu'i shugs kyis la ba lag tu byin pa dang / de khas bub tu 'gyel nas nye dga'as rdog pas bsnun te smras pa/ gcer bu pa sgre byi gtsug lag khang sla tsas ma gtal bar song shig /btsun pa nye dga' gal te ma gum na mchi ste/ slan chad rgyal byed kyi tshal du mi mchi'o/ /de ni re zhig byung ba yin gyi/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das re zhig 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhi 'cha' bar ni mi mdzad do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe na dge slong drug sde dag mngon mtshan can gyis spyod pa rnam pa sna tshogs byed de/ kun tu sbyor bar byed/ rab tu sbyor bar

byed/ bun 'gyed par byed/ skyed 'gyed par byed/ byas pa'i phyir byas pa dang / byas pa'i phyir ma byas pa dang / ma byas pa'i phyir byas pa dang / ma byas pa'i phyir ma byas pa gtong bar byed do/ /ji ltar kun du sbyor bar byed ce na/ kun du rtsom par byed/ yul tshol bar byed/ shing rta sogs par byed/ yul du 'gro ba'i rdzas shom par byed/ le'u pa dang / gro ba dang / snag tsha dang / smyu gu dang / yi ge pa tshol bar byed de/ de ltar kun du sbyor bar byed do/ /ji ltar rab tu sbyor bar byed ce na/ brgyad shas dang / bcu shas dang / bcu gnyis shas kyi phyir dbang po dang / gro ba dang / snag tsha dang / smyu gu dang / yi ge pa tshol bar byed de/ de ltar rab tu sbyor bar byed do/ /ji ltar bun 'gyed par byed ce na/ nas dang 'bru rnying pa gser phye dang nye sde'i phyir gtong ba dang / gzhal ba'i snod dang / bre'u chung dang / phul dang gro ba dang / snag tsha dang / smyu gu dang / yi ge pa tshol bar byed de/ de ltar bun 'gyed par byed do/ /ji ltar skyed 'gyed par byed ce na/ dung gi tshogs kyi phyir nor bu'i tshogs gtong bar byed pa dang / nor bu'i tshogs kyi phyir mu tig gi tshogs gtong bar byed pa dang / mu tig gi tshogs kyi phyir bai ḍūr+ya'i tshogs gtong bar byed cing / dpang po dang / gro ba dang / snag tsha dang / smyu gu dang / yi ge pa tshol bar byed de/ de ltar skyed 'gyed par byed do/ /ji ltar byas pa'i phyir byas pa gtong bar byed ce na/ gser mngon mtshan can gyi phyir mngon mtshan can gtong bar byed de/ de ltar byas pa'i phyir byas pa gtong bar byed do/ /ji ltar byas pa'i phyir ma byas pa gtong bar byed ce na/ gser mngon mtshan can gyi phyir mngon mtshan can med pa gtong bar byed de/ de ltar byas pa'i phyir ma byas pa gtong bar byed do/ /ji ltar ma byas pa'i phyir byas pa gtong bar byed ce na/ gser mngon mtshan can ma yin pa'i phyir mngon mtshan can gtong bar byed de/ de ltar ma byas pa'i phyir byas pa gtong bar byed do/ /ji ltar ma byas pa'i phyir ma byas pa gtong bar byed ce na/ gser mngon mtshan can

ma yin pa'i phyir mngon mtshan can ma yin par gtong bar byed de/ de ltar ma byas pa'i phyir ma byas pa gtong bar byed do/ /gzhan mu stegs can dag shes ldan dag shākya'i bu'i dge sbyong rnams ni ma log ma spangs so sor ma spangs pa yin te/ 'di ltar mngon mtshan can gyis spyod pa rnam pa sna tshogs byed de/ kun du sbyor bar byed/ rab tu sbyor bar byed/ bun 'gyed par byed/ skyed 'gyed par byed/ byas pa'i phyir byas pa dang / byas pa'i phyir ma byas pa dang ma byas pa'i phyir byas pa dang ma byas pa'i phyir ma byas pa gtong bar byed do/ /bram ze dang / khyim bdag rnams kyang mngon mtshan can gyis spyod pa rnam pa sna tshogs byed de/ kun du sbyor bar byed/ rab tu sbyor bar byed/ bun 'gyed par byed/ skyed 'gyed par byed/ byas pa'i phyir byas pa dang / byas pa'i phyir ma byas pa dang ma byas pa'i phyir byas pa dang / ma byas pa'i phyir ma byas pa gtong bar byed na shes ldan dag shākya'i bu'i dge sbyong rnams dang bram ze dang / khyim bdag rnams la bye brag ni ci yod/ bsam pa ni ci yod/ tha dad du bya ba ni ci yod/ su zhig dge sbyong mgo reg 'di dag la bsod snyoms sbyin pa dang bya bar sems zhes smod par byed/ phyar ka gtong bar byed/ kha zer bar byed pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byung ba 'di dang / gleng gzhi 'di dang / skabs 'di la dge slong gi dge 'dun bsdu ba mdzad do zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mkhyen bzhin du rmed par mdzad pa ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong drug sde dag la rmas pa/ dge slong dag khyed mngon mtshan can gyis spyod pa rnam pa sna tshogs byed pa bden nam/ btsun pa mad do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge sbyong gi tshul ma yin pa/ rjes su mthun pa ma yin pa/ rung ba ma yin pa/ tshul dang mthun pa ma yin pa de ni rab tu byung bas bya ba ma yin no/ /zhes rnam par smad pa mdzad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das

kyis rnam grangs du mas rnam par smad nas dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na phan yon bcu yang dag par gzigs pas 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhi bca' bar bya ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /nga'i nyan thos rnams kyis 'dul ba la bslab pa'i gzhi 'di ltar gdon par bya ste/ yang dge slong gang mngon mtshan can gyis spyod pa rnam pa sna tshogs byed na spang ba'i ltung byed do/ /yang dge slong gang zhes bya ba ni drug sde dag gam/ gzhan yang de lta bu gang yin pa'o/ /mngon mtshan can gyis spyod pa rnam pa sna tshogs zhes bya ba ni rnam pa du ma'o/ /byed na zhes bya ba ni kun du sbyor bar byed pa dang / rab tu sbyor bar byed pa dang / bun 'gyed par byed pa dang / skyed 'gyed par byed pa lhag par spyod par byed na'o/ /spang ba'i ltung byed do zhes bya ba ni dngos po de spangs nas ltung byed kyi ltung ba bshags par bya ste/ des na spang ba'i ltung byed do zhes gsungs so/ /de la ltung bar ji ltar 'gyur zhe na/ dge slong gis rnyed pa 'dod pas yul gyi tha snyad kyi zong kun du sbyor bar byed cing / de de la shing rta dang glang dang gla mi dang / dpang po dang / gro ba dang / snag tsha dang / smyu gu dang / yi ge pa tshol bar byed de/ sho gam dang la gcan dang gru btsas sbyin par byed na ji srid du rnyed pa dag bdag gir mi byed pa de srid du nyes byas su 'gyur la/ rnyed pa bdag gir byed pa na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis rnyed pa 'dod pas dbyig gam/ gser rab tu sbyor bar byed cing / de de la dpang po dang / gro ba dang snag tsha dang / smyu gu dang / yi ge pa tshol bar byed na ji srid du rnyed pa bdag gir mi byed pa de srid du nyes byas su 'gyur la/ rnyed pa dag bdag gir byed na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis rnyed pa 'dod pas nas dang / 'bru'i bun 'gyed par byed cing / de de la gzhal blugs dang / bre'u chung dang / phul dang / dpang po dang / gro ba dang / snag tsha dang / smyu gu dang /

yi ge pa tshol bar byed na ji srid du rnyed pa bdag gir mi byed pa de srid du nyes byas su 'gyur la/ rnyed pa bdag gir byed pa na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis rnyed pa 'dod pas dung gi tshogs kyi phyir nor bu'i tshogs gtong bar byed pa dang / nor bu'i tshogs kyi phyir mu tig gi tshogs gtong bar byed pa dang / mu tig gi tshogs kyi phyir bai ḍūr+ya'i tshogs gtong bar byed cing / de de la dpang po dang / gro ba dang / snag tsha dang / smyu gu dang / yi ge pa tshol bar byed na/ ji srid du rnyed pa bdag gir mi byed pa de srid du nyes byas su 'gyur la/ rnyed pa bdag gir byed na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro zhes de ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhi bca' bar mdzad do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yangs pa can na spre'u rdzing gi 'gram na khang pa brtsegs pa'i khang bzangs na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe na yangs pa can pa'i lits+tsha bī dag gis khang pa dag drug rtseg dang bdun rtseg tu byed do/ /yangs pa can gyi lits+tsha bī rnams kyi khang pa ji lta ba de bzhin du gtsug lag khang dag kyang drug rtseg dang bdun rtseg tu byed pas de dag mtho ches pas brtsigs shing brtsigs shing rdib nas sbyin bdag dag gis bsams pa/ bdag cag gson zhing 'dug ste/ 'tsho zhing sdod pa rnams kyi gtsug lag khang dag kyang 'di ltar 'jig na shi ba rnams kyi ji ltar 'gyur/ bdag cag gis mkhar len gyi rgyur dge 'dun la mi zad pa dbul bar bya'o snyam nas de dag mi zad pa thogs te dge slong rnams kyi gan du dong nas phyin pa dang / dge slong rnams la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'phags pa dag mkhar len gyi slad du mi zad pa 'di dag bzhes shig dge slong rnams kyis smras pa/ bzhin bzangs dag bcom ldan 'das kyis bslab pa'i gzhi bca' bar mdzad pas bdag cag mi len to zhes zer ba'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge 'dun gyi phyir mkhar len gyi rgyu mi zad par blang bar bya'o/ /gzhan yang

dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gtsug lag khang ni sum rtseg tu bya'o dge slong ma'i dge 'dun gyi dbyar khang ni nyis rtseg tu bya'o/ /dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das las mnyan nas mi zad pa blangs nas dge 'dun gyi mdzod du bcug ste bzhag go/ /sbyin bdag dag 'ongs te smras pa/ 'phags pa dag ci'i slad du gtsug lag khang gi mkhar len mi bgyid kār ṣā pa ṇa dag med do/ /'o na bdag cag gis khyed la mi zad pa dag ma phul lam/ dge slong rnams kyis smras pa/ ci kho bo cag gis mi zad pa dag zos snyama'am/ dge 'dun gyi mdzod na 'dug go/ /'phags pa dag de lta na mi zad par mi 'gyur gyi 'di ltar zad par 'gyur te ci bdag cag gi sdum pa na gnas ma mchis snyama'am/ ci'i slad du rab tu sbyor bar mi mdzad/ dge slong rnams kyis smras pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bslab pa'i gzhi bca' ba mdzad pas bdag cag rab tu sbyor bar mi byed do zhes zer ba'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge 'dun gyi phyir mkhar len gyi rgyu mi zad pa rab tu sbyor bar bya'o/ /de bzhin du bram ze dang / khyim bdag dad pa can dag sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun gyi phyir mi zad pa 'bul nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun gyi phyir mi zad pa rab tu sbyor bar bya zhing de las skyed gang grub pa des sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun la mchod par bya'o/ /de dag gis de dag nyid la byin nas de dag la 'das pa na rtsod par byed cing / 'phags pa dag ci'i phyir bdag nyid kyi nor las rtsod pa byung zhes zer ba'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de dag la sbyin par mi bya'o/ /de dag gis phyug po dag la byin nas/ de dag la 'das pa na mthu dang ldan pa la rten cing mi ster ba dang / bla'i grwa'i mthus mi ster nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de dag la sbyin par mi bya'o/ /de dag
